jetskis_jetski_desc: A fast little boat for one, pushed along by a surtling core's fire instead of the wind. Build it on the water.
jetskis_help: W go, Shift+W full speed, S reverse, A and D steer, Jump to get off.
jetskis_too_far: Get closer to the jet ski to climb on.
jetskis_too_heavy: You are carrying too much to ride.
